description: This file is a JavaScript module that defines a web scraper function for the website 'closetcooking.com'. It uses cheerio for HTML parsing and puppeteerFetch for fetching web pages, and exports a function that extracts recipe data from the specified website.

classes.name: RecipeSchema
classes.description: A schema object for storing recipe details such as image, name, ingredients, instructions, tags, time, and servings.

methods.name: closetCooking
methods.description: An asynchronous function that fetches a recipe page from 'closetcooking.com', parses the HTML to extract recipe details, and returns a Recipe object.
